description: Edit this sheet of eight small chibi pixel art figures: the top row walks towards the viewer, the bottom row walks away from the viewer. Dress every figure in the same outfit and change nothing else: keep each figure's pose, size, place, bald head, ears and face exactly as they are, with the same chunky pixel size, the same thick dark outline and the same flat shading with a few tones per colour. The outfit: a brown leather flight jacket with a thick cream fleece collar kept below the chin, khaki cargo trousers with side pockets and brown boots. Seen from behind: the back of the brown leather flight jacket with its cream fleece collar, khaki trousers and brown boots. Simple bold shapes, no fine pattern. The hands stay bare. Transparent background, nothing else added.
